(n) Rotate the camshaft with a wrench at the hexagon position, bring the forward straight pin up.
(o) Loosen the 12 bearing cap bolts as shown, until they can be turned by hand; retighten, in several passes.
Torque: 20 N·m (200 kgf·cm, 14 ft·lbf)

P02695

120° 120°

(p) Turn the camshaft 1/3 of revolution.
(q) Loosen the 8 bearing cap bolts as shown, until they can be turned by hand; retighten, in several passes.
Torque: 20 N·m (200 kgf·cm, 14 ft·lbf)

P02696

120° 120°

(r) Turn the camshaft a further 1/3 of a revolution.
(s) Loosen the 8 bearing cap bolts as shown, until they can be turned by hand; retighten, in several passes.
Torque: 20 N·m (200 kgf·cm, 14 ft·lbf)

4. CHECK AND ADJUST VALVE CLEARANCE
(See page EM-4 )
Turn the camshaft, and position the cam lobe upward, check and adjust the valve clearance.

A02174

5. INSTALL NO.4 TIMING BELT COVER
Install the timing belt cover with 4 bolts.
Torque: 8.0 N·m (80 kgf·cm, 71 in.·lbf)

P03960

6. INSTALL CAMSHAFT TIMING PULLEYS
(a) Align the camshaft knock pin with the groove in the pulley, and slide on the pulley.
(b) Temporarily install the timing pulley bolt.
